messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@brightbank.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-12T09:12:05+02:00
Subject: Request - current processor roster + clarification on recent proxy change

Hi Mina,

Hope you're well. As part of our upcoming privacy review we need a current inventory of Redwood's subprocessors that may handle BrightBank customer data (production or telemetry) for EU-region customers. Specifically:

- Full list of subprocessors active as of today, with country of processing and data categories handled.
- A note for any processors added in the last 60 days (name, start date, brief purpose).
- Any providers that will route data outside the EU (including temporary/edge proxies).

Separately, we received an internal alert suggesting Redwood introduced a new proxy/relay vendor for telemetry (we saw a reference to "EdgeProxy Ltd"). Can you confirm whether EdgeProxy is in-scope for BrightBank data, and if so whether logs or KV/cache snapshots are ever exported outside the EU? If there are mitigations (onshore-only keys, limited retention, pseudonymization) please call them out.

We'd like to close this item for our SOC review by EOD Thursday. If helpful, please attach the subprocessor roster and any DPA addenda.

Thanks - Elena
Procurement | BrightBank
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-12T14:05:30+02:00
Subject: Re: Request - current processor roster + clarification on recent proxy change

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is the current inventory CSV (subprocessors_20270812.csv) and a DPA addendum (dpa_addendum_brightbank_20270812.pdf) prepared for customers asking about recent onboarding. High level summary below and mitigations for BrightBank: 

- EdgeProxy Ltd (UK) - onboarding completed 2027-08-01. Role: edge HTTP relay for observability telemetry (metrics, sampled traces). It does not receive customer PII or full request payloads; only id-less telemetry and sampled spans are forwarded. Logs transmitted are truncated and hashed, and retention at the edge is 7 days by default.
- CacheWave (US) - transient KV cache used to accelerate cold-starts. For enterprise EU customers we enable onshore fallback by default; encryption at rest uses customer-managed KMS when requested.
- StreamPulse (DE) - streaming telemetry and audit logs; remains EU-hosted for BrightBank.

Mitigations specific to EdgeProxy for BrightBank:
- EU-only routing commitment for account BB-2027-045 (described in the DPA addendum).
- Field-level stripping: request identifiers and user identifiers are hashed with a salt before export; full request paths and payloads are never forwarded.
- Retention: 7 days for edge telemetry, no backups outside the EU for BrightBank.

Attachments (stubs): subprocessors_20270812.csv, dpa_addendum_brightbank_20270812.pdf, dataflow-diagram-brief.txt. Drive link and HubSpot record included below.

Drive (read-only): https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-dataflow
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/BB-2027-045

If you'd like we can produce a tenant-specific exportability matrix (per-field residency proof) by EOD Thursday. Please confirm and we'll queue it.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Privacy & Compliance Manager
